original_method: Map device index/card/UUID/BDF/OAM and baseline GPU/BMC/CPER/bad-page state; use secure authenticated HTTPS Redfish rather than hard-coded unauthenticated HTTP where supported; record all existing entry IDs/timestamps; FAE-approve exact -d0 -b2 -t8 semantics; inject once under OOB/telemetry; identify new CPER by set/time/event correlation rather than max ID alone; download/hash/decode securely; validate section identities, OAM/location, GC/UMC banks as applicable, extended codes/types/severities and poison-consumption semantics; snapshot retired pages; controlled warm reset; confirm same normalized address set and healthy recovery.
manual_activity: AMD/FAE approves injection semantics and decoded CPER oracle; BMC/GPU owner controls dedicated SUT, credentials, reset and recovery.
safety_requirements: Abort on GPU loss, fatal error, thermal/power or boot failure

independent_technical_reasoning: A maximum numeric CPER ID is not reliable when entries are concurrent or nonsequential; the new artifact must be correlated by pre/post set, time and event content.
